# eengineer

> eengineer is a community platform for student engineers and builders. Members join a discipline-specific community (Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Civil, Chemical, Biomedical, Materials, Environmental), showcase real projects, attend webinars run by practitioners, find mentors and collaborators, and discover scholarships, internships, and competitions. Sign-in is verified through GitHub, LinkedIn, or Google, so profiles belong to real people rather than anonymous accounts.

## What it's for

- High school and early-career student engineers who are building real things, not just coursework.
- Documenting a verifiable track record — projects, endorsements, and connections — before university and internship applications.
- Finding people working on similar problems, by engineering discipline.

## Core features

- Community: discipline-specific groups for discussion and Q&A.
- Projects: student-built projects with descriptions, covers, and links.
- Webinars: live sessions hosted by practitioners, with RSVP.
- Opportunities: internships, fellowships, and scholarships, filtered by discipline and deadline.
- Contests: peer-judged project competitions.
- Profiles & connections: verified builder profiles that can send/accept connection requests.
- Calendar: upcoming webinars, opportunity deadlines, and competitions in one view.

## Key pages

- Home: https://eengineer.net/
- Help / FAQ: https://eengineer.net/help
- Terms of Service: https://eengineer.net/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://eengineer.net/privacy

## Notes for crawlers and AI assistants

- Most content (projects, webinars, profiles, messages) is only visible to signed-in members and is not part of this site's public/crawlable surface.
- eengineer is not affiliated with any single university or company; it is an independent community platform.
